lab_questions.title: Enforcing Concurrent Device Limits
lab_questions.description: A video streaming service allows 2 active devices for basic users. Users are sharing their passwords with 10 people simultaneously.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Session Eviction Logic
tasks.description:
The login endpoint issues JWTs endlessly.

**Goal:** Track active sessions in the database or Redis. Upon a new login, check `active_session_count`. If it exceeds the limit (2), automatically revoke or delete the *oldest* active session token.

tasks.title: List Active Devices
tasks.description:
Users should be able to view all devices currently streaming on their account.

**Goal:** Implement a `GET /api/streaming/sessions/` endpoint. It must require authentication and return a JSON array of all active sessions belonging to the authenticated user, serialized exactly as `[{"token": "...", "created_at": "..."}]` sorted by oldest first.

tasks.title: Manual Device Revocation
tasks.description:
Users should be able to manually revoke a specific session to kick off another user.

**Goal:** Implement a `DELETE /api/streaming/sessions/<token>/` endpoint. It must require authentication. If the specified token belongs to the authenticated user, delete it from the database and return `204 No Content`. If the token does not exist or belongs to a different user, return `404 Not Found`.
